description: Enumerate every scheduled job (cron and one-time), optionally narrowed by status. Use when you need a schedule whose tag or id you do not already know — for example to locate and clear a stale recurring cron. Read-only introspection; does not modify state.
embedding_description: Enumerate all scheduled jobs with no tag required, optionally filtered by status. Find a schedule whose tag or id is unknown, audit every cron and one-time job, or locate a stale recurring schedule before clearing it. Read-only; the tag-agnostic companion to get_schedules_by_tag.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Every schedule (optionally status-filtered): each entry carries schedule_id, type, status, cron_expression/run_at, label, tags, and execution context (session_id/flow_id); plus a top-level count and the status_filter that was applied (null when unfiltered).
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: All schedules were retrieved. To cancel one, call clear_scheduled_action with its schedule_id; to cancel a group, call clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag with a tag taken from the listing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Enumerating all schedules for introspection or stale-schedule cleanup
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ExecutionError: the scheduling service is unavailable or failed to query schedules.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the scheduling service is running and retry. To narrow a large result set, pass the optional status filter (scheduled, running, completed, cancelled, error, paused).
